_comment: FROZEN. Do not edit to make a red test green — find out what diverged. The hash moves only when the SIMULATION legitimately changes; the history below records every time it has. As of step 8 this fixture also pins the balance data it was recorded under, in "data", and the replay installs it. That is what makes the hash independent of tuning: a red golden test now means the arithmetic diverged, never that someone edited a creep. Regenerating it requires changing "data" on purpose.
_hashHistory: ded775ca - step 4, towers began shooting (real behaviour change)
adc38458 - step 5, leaks cost lives AND hashState was fixed to cover gold/towers/lives, which it had silently never covered
f390d440 - step 6, two lanes, real creep roster, economy; creeps now arrive from sends rather than a config

ce02e89d - step 9, the lane turned vertical and shrank to 8 x 24 (a real geometry change: every route, every tower range overlap and every leak timing moved). The command log was remapped onto the new board; the schedule and the balance data in "data" are untouched.

bd025b5c - the spawn queue was removed. A send used to enqueue its creeps and the lane released one every four ticks; it now spawns them on the tick the command applies, because gold is meant to be the only thing rationing a send. Separation between simultaneous arrivals moved from the queue's timing to spawnPointFor's along-path offset, so every creep in this replay enters at a different position than it used to and the whole match diverges from tick one. A real behaviour change; the command log and the balance data in "data" are untouched.
_coverage: Runs the full 2600 ticks without either player reaching zero, so the sim never freezes and everything after that tick keeps being exercised. Both lanes are live: player 0 ends on 14 lives / 6 leaks / 23 kills / income 39, player 1 on 14 lives / 6 leaks / 15 kills / income 53. Exercises building, upgrading, selling, sends from both sides, sends spawning on the spot, tower fire, kill bounty, leaks costing lives, income ticks and tier-1 unlocks.

data._purseComment: Added when the opening purse became freezable. These are the values this match was recorded under, in the pre-x10 scale. Pinning them is what keeps expectedHash at ce02e89d across the x10 rescale, and that the hash did not move is the proof the rescale changed no arithmetic.
